title: Charge Rule: Vehicle Amendment Charge, Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing
content:
## Rule

A vehicle amendment reports to the ordering state one vehicle endorsement of the certified policy on a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate that lists the scheduled vehicles. A vehicle amendment is charged the vehicle-amendment rate, which is 15.00 on every certificate type, and the vehicle amendment charge is that rate booked to the cent.

The vehicle amendment charge is the vehicle-amendment line charge plus the vehicle-report lateness charge, the vehicle-amendment envelope charge and the vehicle-amendment standing surcharge, the sum rounded to the cent, and it is booked once per vehicle amendment, on its transmission.

## Components as charged

| Component | Amount |
|---|---|
| Vehicle-amendment rate | 15.00, on every certificate type |
| Vehicle-amendment line charge | The vehicle-amendment rate, once |
| Vehicle-report lateness charge | 0.00 |
| Vehicle-amendment envelope charge | 0.00 |
| Vehicle-amendment standing surcharge | 0.00 |
| Vehicle amendment charge | The four amounts above it added together, rounded to the cent |

The four components are added as they stand; the rounding to the cent is applied once, to the total.

## Worked figure

A vehicle amendment on a Cardinal SR-22 Owner Certificate:
- vehicle-amendment rate 15.00, line charge 15.00;
- lateness 0.00, envelope 0.00, standing 0.00;
- vehicle amendment charge: 15.00 plus 0.00 plus 0.00 plus 0.00, rounded to the cent: **15.00**.

## Points of reference

- **Per amendment.** Two vehicle endorsements reported by two vehicle amendments are two charges, each booked on its own transmission.
- **Same rate on every certificate.** The rate does not differ between the in-state, out-of-state and FR-44 owner certificates.
